name: manim-lens
description: Video/Image live previews and code snippets for manim.

manim-lens.defaultManimPath.description: Specify the absolute path to the Manim executable file.

manim-lens.commandLineArgs.description: Input additional command line arguments for Manim. Refer to Manim documentation for options. Use the config file for quality args like 'ql'.

manim-lens.runOnSave.description: Enable or disable the automatic running of a previously run file upon saving.

manim-lens.previewShowProgressOnIdle.description: Choose whether to show the video progress bar in the player while the job is idle.

manim-lens.previewProgressColor.description: Define the progress bar color, using either hex codes (e.g., `#F1F1F1`) or theme color names (e.g., `button.border`).

manim-lens.previewAutoPlay.description: Decide whether to automatically play the video or not when it is ready.

manim-lens.previewLooping.description: Enable or disable continuous looping of the video preview.

manim-lens.manimExecutableVersion.description: Specify the version of the Manim executable used by the extension.

manim-lens.terminalCommand.description: Define a terminal command to run post-render. Use variables: {outputPath}, {sourcePath}, and {sceneName} as needed.

manim-lens.preview.description: Display the preview after rendering. This should be enabled at all times except for when you're using the extension solely to render.

manim-lens.checkeredBackground.description: Show a checkered background behind the video preview.

manim-lens.enableAudio.description: Play audio from a separate WAV/MP3 file alongside the video preview. The WAV is generated alongside the MP4 by manim, or an MP3 from the media/voiceovers folder by manim-voiceover.

commands.title: Manim: Cancel Active Job of Current File
Manim: Sync Internal Manim Config with Local Executable
